/.title: GoogleIndexing.com | Google SEO Indexing API Automation
/.description: Crawl your site, submit new pages through Google's official Indexing API on a schedule, and see URL by URL what Google actually indexed. Free plan available.
/.h1: Get your pages into Google, and see which ones made it
text: GoogleIndexing.com crawls your site, submits new and changed pages through Google's official Indexing API on a schedule, and checks every URL with Google's URL Inspection so you know what is actually indexed.
Start free: a 14-day trial with 100 URL submissions, then 50 a month. Works with WordPress, Shopify, nopCommerce, Next.js and custom sites.

/pricing.title: Pricing | GoogleIndexing.com
/pricing.description: Start free with 50 URL submissions a month. Paid plans submit up to 200 URLs a day per Google project, with scheduled crawls and per-URL index status.
text: Start free with a 14-day trial of 100 URL submissions, then 50 submissions every month. Paid plans submit up to 200 URLs a day per Google Cloud project, Google's own limit.
Every plan includes scheduled crawls, automatic submission and index status verified with Google's URL Inspection.

/tools/indexability-checker.title: Free Google Indexability Checker: Why Isn't My Page Indexed? | GoogleIndexing.com
/tools/indexability-checker.description: Free tool: check if Google can index any page. Tests robots.txt, noindex tags, X-Robots-Tag, canonical, redirects, status codes and thin content, with a plain-English fix for each issue.
text: Paste any page address to see whether Google can index it. The checker tests the HTTP status and redirects, robots.txt rules for Googlebot, the X-Robots-Tag header, meta robots noindex, the canonical tag and how much content is in the HTML.
Each problem comes with a plain-English fix. No sign-up needed.
